evidence: Vulg. 1 Cor. 15.33: corrumpunt mōrēs bonōs colloquia mala (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The plural of mōs, custom, way: a person’s ways, and so his character and morals, good or bad (Lewis & Short). Mōrēs are also a people’s customs and manners.

phrases.latin: Piget mē neglegentiae meae. — Nōn satis est dolēre, nisi mōrēs mūtāre velīs.
phrases.english: “I’m sorry I was careless.” — “Being sorry isn’t enough unless you mean to change your ways.”
